_source: Team4_SAM_Inputs.xlsx 'SAM cases' sheet; PVWatts v8 (PySAM.Pvwattsv8) variable names

module.name: Hyperion HY-WH108P8-410
module._note: module_type 1 = premium (PVWatts); kW per m2 of module area = 0.15 kWdc/m2 / GCR 0.76

_losses_note: PVWatts default total is 14.08 % including a generic 3 % shading; sites in this inventory carry their own LiDAR shading (shading_azal / shading_diff), so use losses_pct_site_shading (the same components without shading).

roof_flat_rack._note: fixed roof mount, 10 deg rows; azimuth = row_azimuth (edge-aligned) or 180

roof_flush_pitch._note: flush on the pitched face: tilt/azimuth = LiDAR plane; 0.9 packing
roof_flush_pitch.mount: flush rail mount on the pitched face (penetrations)

carport.mount: steel carport canopy (single/double cantilever) over stall rows
carport._note: kW per m2 of canopy over the stall rows (modules ~0.197 kW/m2, ~0.9 packing); v1 used 0.10 per m2 of whole lot incl. aisles

garage_top_canopy.azimuth: row_azimuth (stall rows follow the garage grid)
garage_top_canopy.mount: elevated steel canopy over the top parking deck
garage_top_canopy.structure: canopy columns on the garage column grid; structural review of the (often post-tensioned) deck
garage_top_canopy._note: top decks stay in use for parking, so a ballasted rack is not an option

screening._note: cells losing > 20 % of their unshaded annual irradiance are not usable (NREL rooftop-potential rule: >= 80 % of unshaded)

pysam_shading._note: PySAM 7 ignores shading_azal / shading_diff unless these enable flags are set to 1 (verified: losses then match the inventory's own TMY estimate within 0.2 pp).

costs._status: PLACEHOLDERS from Team4_SAM_Inputs 'Economics' (NREL Q1 2023 / LBNL 2025 benchmarks) - Felipe to replace

finance._source: Team4_SAM_Inputs 'Economics': LCOE = (capex x CRF + O&M) / (yield x 0.956); 6 %, 25 yr

model._status: PLACEHOLDERS - plausible orders of magnitude, not from a cited source; replace with the team's cost table

scale._note: base $/W applies at ref_kwdc; ~-20 % per 10x size (exponent 0.10)

height._note: crane / material lift / access above ~3 storeys

reroof._note: remove & reinstall the array once during its life when the building (proxy for roof) is >= 20 yr old

garage._note: structural review / reinforcement of the (post-tensioned) top deck

interconnection._note: small sites tie into a nearby building service; larger ones need a pad-mount transformer + switchgear on the 12.47 kV loop and medium-voltage ductbank (distance to the nearest TAMU substation as proxy)

siteprep._note: grading, fencing, access on open land
